project.theme_name: GRM AI-Powered Virtual ISP Headquarters & Showroom

assumptions: All geometry is a conceptual virtual envelope (20 m × 15 m × 3.2 m), not a building survey; no construction, fire-safety, load or accessibility-code compliance is claimed. Licensed professionals must verify any physical use.
Fixed elements (columns, stairs, windows, elevators, fire exits) were not supplied and are not assumed; all shell walls are virtual and need verification.

Coordinates: metres, origin at floor southwest corner, x east, z north, y up. Object position = bottom-centre of its bounding box (wall-mounted items: their own centre); scale = bounding-box size in metres; rotation = radians (y = 0 faces north).
Zone bounds convert the template percentages to metres of the 20 × 15 m envelope; zone size is [width, ceiling height, depth].

Entry is a virtual portal at the south wall centre (x = 10, z = 0). Exit location was not supplied; a conceptual return-to-lobby portal and always-visible HUD control are provided, flagged as not real egress. The building lobby link and adjacent-floor links are empty and pending.
A 1.2 m centre aisle (x 9.4–10.6) is kept clear between the two demo wings; 13 bots are grouped by department across six zones to avoid crowding the route.

Website and Facebook URLs were not supplied, so those signs are labeled link-pending info panels; no URLs were invented. The logo asset path is the placeholder {{GRM_LOGO_ASSET_URL}} and the official logo must be used unaltered.
Internet plans (55/105/155/205/305 Mbps at PHP 999/1,299/1,499/1,999/2,499 per month) and support phone 0993 291 3471 come from a user-provided GRM promotional image; verify before public launch.

Active bots at launch: GIA, ACE, FINN, TESS, OMAR (open_bot_chat:<id> keys must be implemented by the host app). The other 8 are planned/demo-only; their hotspots open an info panel and they are not claimed to modify live accounts or network settings.
In-app action keys (play_demo:*, open_info_panel:*, open_bot_chat:*) are contract names for the host app to implement; none are claimed as already implemented.

Public kiosks show general service information, public plans and sample non-personal data only. Billing, HR, subscriber data, NOC controls and analytics need authenticated authorized access; network changes, financial adjustments, disconnections and sensitive personnel decisions need human approval.
Initial camera is placed south of the floor looking north so the entrance is in the foreground; the template's relative z of 1.35 (north side) was mirrored for that reason.
Lighting values describe the day preset; a night preset should lower ambient/directional and raise spot and area intensity. Avatar GLB assets are placeholders (placeholder://) to be supplied.
Possible future integrations (CRM, Google Sheets, Slack, n8n, ISP equipment management) are not asserted as connected.

fixed_elements: Not provided – no columns, stairs, windows, elevators or fire exits assumed; verification required

responsive.desktop: Free-roam 3D with WASD/arrow keys and mouse look, click or Enter on hotspots, guided-tour button, day/night toggle, floor selector and an always-visible Return to Lobby control; initial view cam_overview.
responsive.mobile: 2D clickable floor map with bot cards (active/planned badges), direct Talk-to-bot actions, plans and support-phone panels; no mandatory free-roam movement; optional tap-to-teleport between camera viewpoints.
responsive.reduced_motion: Honor prefers-reduced-motion: disable idle avatar animation, camera fly-throughs and pulsing highlights; jump between viewpoints instantly; every hotspot reachable by keyboard tab order with visible focus and text labels.
